items.title_en: Ranbir Kapoor 'Sadly Leaving Places' Shot Returns in 'TJMM', Clip Goes Viral

items.summary_en: Ranbir Kapoor 'sadly leaving places' roster gets a new addition with this Tu Jhoothi Main Makkar scene, as pointed out by a Twitter user.
